run_download_inaturalist: run the script to download, extract, and copy a subset of iNaturalist images from an archive
run_download_archive: run download_archive to wget a tar.gz file from a URL to a destination directory
run_extract_archive: run extract_archive to decompress a gzipped tar file into a specified directory
run_copy_images: run copy_images to copy a subset of images from an extracted archive based on a JSON mapping
run_main_pipeline: run the main pipeline with argparse flags for raw images folder, processed images folder, and subset JSON
